pairs: Jesus autem plenus Spiritu Sancto regressus est a Jordane:
And Jesus, filled with the Holy Spirit, returned from the Jordan.
et agebatur a Spiritu in desertum
And he was urged by the Spirit into the wilderness
diebus quadraginta, et tentabatur a diabolo.
for forty days, and he was tested by the devil.
Et nihil manducavit in diebus illis:
And he ate nothing in those days.
et consummatis illis esuriit.
And when they were completed, he was hungry.
Dixit autem illi diabolus:
Then the devil said to him,
Si Filius Dei es,
“If you are the Son of God,
dic lapidi huic ut panis fiat.
speak to this stone, so that it may be made into bread.”
Et respondit ad illum Jesus:
And Jesus answered him,
Scriptum est:
“It is written:
Quia non in solo pane vivit homo,
‘Man shall not live by bread alone,
sed in omni verbo Dei.
but by every word of God.’”
Et duxit illum diabolus in montem excelsum,
And the devil led him onto a high mountain,
et ostendit illi omnia regna orbis terræ in momento temporis,
and he showed him all the kingdoms of the world in a moment of time,
et ait illi:
and he said to him:
Tibi dabo potestatem hanc universam,
“To you, I will give all this power,
et gloriam illorum: quia mihi tradita sunt,
and its glory. For they have been handed over to me,
et cui volo do illa.
and I give them to whomever I wish.
Tu ergo si adoraveris coram me,
Therefore, if you will worship before me,
erunt tua omnia.
all will be yours.”
Et respondens Jesus,
And in response,
dixit illi:
Jesus said to him:
Scriptum est:
“It is written:
Dominum Deum tuum adorabis,
‘You shall worship the Lord your God,
et illi soli servies.
and you shall serve him alone.’”
Et duxit illum in Jerusalem,
And he brought him to Jerusalem,
et statuit eum super pinnam templi,
and he set him on the parapet of the temple,
et dixit illi:
and he said to him:
Si Filius Dei es,
“If you are the Son of God,
mitte te hinc deorsum.
cast yourself down from here.
Scriptum est enim quod angelis suis mandavit de te,
For it is written that he has given his Angels charge over you,
ut conservent te:
so that they may guard you,
et quia in manibus tollent te,
and so that they may take you into their hands,
ne forte offendas ad lapidem pedem tuum.
lest perhaps you may hurt your foot against a stone.”
Et respondens Jesus,
And in response,
ait illi:
Jesus said to him,
Dictum est:
“It is said:
Non tentabis Dominum Deum tuum.
‘You shall not tempt the Lord your God.’”
Et consummata omni tentatione,
And when all the temptation was completed,
diabolus recessit ab illo,
the devil withdrew from him,
usque ad tempus.
until a time.
Et regressus est Jesus in virtute Spiritus in Galilæam,
And Jesus returned, in the power of the Spirit, into Galilee.
et fama exiit per universam regionem de illo.
And his fame spread throughout the entire region.
Et ipse docebat in synagogis eorum,
And he taught in their synagogues,
et magnificabatur ab omnibus.
and he was magnified by everyone.
Et venit Nazareth,
And he went to Nazareth,
ubi erat nutritus,
where he had been raised.
et intravit secundum consuetudinem suam die sabbati in synagogam,
And he entered into the synagogue, according to his custom, on the Sabbath day.
et surrexit legere.
And he rose up to read.
Et traditus est illi liber Isaiæ prophetæ.
And the book of the prophet Isaiah was handed to him.
Et ut revolvit librum,
And as he unrolled the book,
invenit locum ubi scriptum erat:
he found the place where it was written:
Spiritus Domini super me:
“The Spirit of the Lord is upon me;
propter quod unxit me,
because of this, he has anointed me.
evangelizare pauperibus misit me,
He has sent me to evangelize the poor,
sanare contritos corde,
to heal the contrite of heart,
prædicare captivis remissionem, et cæcis visum,
to preach forgiveness to captives and sight to the blind,
dimittere confractos in remissionem,
to release the broken into forgiveness,
prædicare annum Domini acceptum et diem retributionis.
to preach the acceptable year of the Lord and the day of retribution.”
Et cum plicuisset librum,
And when he had rolled up the book,
reddit ministro,
he returned it to the minister,
et sedit.
and he sat down.
Et omnium in synagoga oculi erant intendentes in eum.
And the eyes of everyone in the synagogue were fixed on him.
Cœpit autem dicere ad illos:
Then he began to say to them,
Quia hodie impleta est hæc scriptura in auribus vestris.
“On this day, this scripture has been fulfilled in your hearing.”
Et omnes testimonium illi dabant:
And everyone gave testimony to him.
et mirabantur in verbis gratiæ, quæ procedebant de ore ipsius,
And they wondered at the words of grace that proceeded from his mouth.
et dicebant:
And they said,
Nonne hic est filius Joseph?
“Is this not the son of Joseph?”
Et ait illis:
And he said to them:
Utique dicetis mihi hanc similitudinem:
“Certainly, you will recite to me this saying, ‘Physician,
Medice cura teipsum: quanta audivimus facta in Capharnaum,
heal yourself.’ The many great things that we have heard were done in Capernaum,
fac et hic in patria tua.
do here also in your own country.”
Ait autem:
Then he said:
Amen dico vobis,
“Amen I say to you,
quia nemo propheta acceptus est in patria sua.
that no prophet is accepted in his own country.
In veritate dico vobis,
In truth,
multæ viduæ erant in diebus Eliæ in Israël,
I say to you,
quando clausum est cælum annis tribus
there were many widows in the days of Elijah in Israel,
et mensibus sex,
when the heavens were closed for three years and six months,
cum facta esset fames magna in omni terra:
when a great famine had occurred throughout the entire land.
et ad nullam illarum missus est Elias,
And to none of these was Elijah sent,
nisi in Sarepta Sidoniæ,
except to Zarephath of Sidon,
ad mulierem viduam.
to a woman who was a widow.
Et multi leprosi erant in Israël sub Eliseo propheta:
And there were many lepers in Israel under the prophet Elisha.
et nemo eorum mundatus est nisi Naaman Syrus.
And none of these was cleansed, except Naaman the Syrian.”
Et repleti sunt omnes in synagoga ira,
And all those in the synagogue, upon hearing these things,
hæc audientes.
were filled with anger.
Et surrexerunt,
And they rose up
et ejecerunt illum extra civitatem:
and drove him beyond the city.
et duxerunt illum usque ad supercilium montis,
And they brought him all the way to the edge of the mount,
super quem civitas illorum erat ædificata,
upon which their city had been built,
ut præcipitarent eum.
so that they might throw him down violently.
Ipse autem transiens per medium illorum,
But passing through their midst,
ibat.
he went away.
Et descendit in Capharnaum civitatem Galilææ,
And he descended to Capernaum, a city of Galilee.
ibique docebat illos sabbatis.
And there he taught them on the Sabbaths.
Et stupebant in doctrina ejus,
And they were astonished at his doctrine,
quia in potestate erat sermo ipsius.
for his word was spoken with authority.
Et in synagoga erat homo habens dæmonium immundum,
And in the synagogue, there was a man who had an unclean demon,
et exclamavit voce magna,
and he cried out with a loud voice,
dicens:
saying:
Sine,
“Let us alone.
quid nobis et tibi,
What are we to you,
Jesu Nazarene?
Jesus of Nazareth?
venisti perdere nos?
Have you come to destroy us?
scio te quis sis,
I know you who you are:
Sanctus Dei.
the Holy One of God.”
Et increpavit illum Jesus,
And Jesus rebuked him,
dicens:
saying,
Obmutesce,
“Be silent
et exi ab eo.
and depart from him.”
Et cum projecisset illum dæmonium in medium,
And when the demon had thrown him into their midst,
exiit ab illo,
he departed from him,
nihilque illum nocuit.
and he no longer harmed him.
Et factus est pavor in omnibus,
And fear fell over them all.
et colloquebantur ad invicem,
And they discussed this among themselves,
dicentes:
saying:
Quod est hoc verbum,
“What is this word?
quia in potestate et virtute imperat immundis spiritibus,
For with authority and power he commands the unclean spirits,
et exeunt?
and they depart.”
Et divulgabatur fama de illo in omnem locum regionis.
And his fame spread to every place in the region.
Surgens autem Jesus de synagoga,
Then Jesus, rising up from the synagogue,
introivit in domum Simonis.
entered into the house of Simon.
Socrus autem Simonis tenebatur magnis febribus:
Now Simon’s mother-in-law was in the grip of a severe fever.
et rogaverunt illum pro ea.
And they petitioned him on her behalf.
Et stans super illam imperavit febri:
And standing over her, he commanded the fever,
et dimisit illam.
and it left her.
Et continuo surgens,
And promptly rising up,
ministrabat illis.
she ministered to them.
Cum autem sol occidisset,
Then, when the sun had set,
omnes qui habebant infirmos variis languoribus, ducebant illos ad eum.
all those who had anyone afflicted with various diseases brought them to him. Then,
At ille singulis manus imponens,
laying his hands on each one of them,
curabat eos.
he cured them.
Exibant autem dæmonia a multis clamantia, et dicentia:
Now demons departed from many of them, crying out and saying,
Quia tu es Filius Dei:
“You are the son of God.”
et increpans non sinebat ea loqui:
And rebuking them, he would not permit them to speak.
quia sciebant ipsum esse Christum.
For they knew him to be the Christ.
Facta autem die egressus ibat in desertum locum,
Then, when it was daytime, going out,
et turbæ requirebant eum,
he went to a deserted place. And the crowds sought him,
et venerunt usque ad ipsum:
and they went all the way to him.
et detinebant illum ne discederet ab eis.
And they detained him, so that he would not depart from them.
Quibus ille ait:
And he said to them,
Quia et aliis civitatibus oportet me evangelizare regnum Dei:
“I must also preach the kingdom of God to other cities,
quia ideo missus sum.
because it was for this reason that I was sent.”
Et erat prædicans in synagogis Galilææ.
And he was preaching in the synagogues of Galilee.
